messages:
Anita Ramos: Quick follow-up from last night's outage (inc-2026-03-21). We need concrete testing/eval additions to prevent recurrence and to make postmortem action tracking easier. Proposed buckets:
- regression: caching edge (prefix mismatch + KV warmup)
- prompt regression: hallucination and context drift
- load test: warmup + burst scenario
- chaos drill: node failover with graceful fallback
Link to postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/inc-2026-03-21
Who's up for owning what? I can coordinate owners and timelines.

Miguel Chen: +1 on all. I can take the KV warmup load test and the chaos drill orchestration. Suggest we add a nightly small-load job that warms shared KV caches for hot models.

Samir Patel: I will own prompt regression sets. Plan: start with 40 prompts across templates we saw fail last week (long prefixes, nested function calls, instruction flips). ETA: initial set by Wed (1802060000). Will push to evals/prompt-sets/incident-driven.

Rina Okoye: I'll own regression suite additions for caching edgecases. Will add targeted unit tests in model-serving and an integration test that simulates partial KV loss. Also request: can we gate deploys if regression failure rate > 2% on these tests?

Anita Ramos: Good. Let's make action items explicit so eng-sre/product can track. Proposed action list:
1) Prompt regression set (owner: Samir) - deliverable: 40 prompts + scoring harness - due 1802060000
2) KV warmup load test (owner: Miguel) - deliverable: CI job + perf baseline - due 1802063600
3) Caching edge regression tests (owner: Rina) - deliverable: unit + integration tests + alert rule - due 1802067200
4) Chaos drill (owner: Miguel) - deliverable: runbook + dry run + post-drill evals - due 1802070000
5) Weekly eval pipeline (owner: qa-bot) - deliverable: scheduled job and dashboard - recur: weekly - start 1802073600

Samir Patel: Draft of prompt harness config (will push as PR). Example config: 
```yaml
eval_name: incident_prompt_regress
prompts_path: evals/prompt-sets/incident-driven.yaml
metrics: [pass_rate, rouge_l, hallucination_score]
thresholds:
  pass_rate: 0.98
  hallucination_score: 0.05
schedule: nightly
```
I'll include the seed cases from the postmortem thread.

Rina Okoye: For the regression gating, recommend CI rule -> block on staging deploys if pass_rate drops below 98% for 2 consecutive runs. I'll file a ticket for the alert/automation.

qa-bot: Scheduled job created: ci/evals/incident_prompt_regress -> runs nightly on small-pool. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/incident-evals

devops-bot: CI job created for kv-warmup: ci/load/kv-warmup, triggers on merge to main and nightly at 03:00 UTC. See run history: https://ci.internal/runs/kv-warmup

Anita Ramos: Thanks all. I'll consolidate these into the postmortem follow-up board and add owners/tags so eng-sre/product can monitor. Can everyone drop a short PR link or ticket by EOD Friday? :thumbsup:

Miguel Chen: Will do. I'll also schedule the chaos drill dry run for next Tue and invite SRE oncall.

Samir Patel: PR incoming today.

Rina Okoye: Ticket created: PM-1428 (regression gating + alert).

Anita Ramos: Great. Closing the thread for now — will ping when items are on the board. If anyone needs help scoping tests, ping me or @Miguel. :rocket:
